label: PF Backlog 40
title: Wire parked follow-up surfacing (parked_review -> follow_up_due event + dashboard view)
body: backlog.parked_review() returns parked items whose follow_up is due, and core/orchestration_context.py already handles the 'follow_up_due' event (-> notify_owner), but nothing emits it on a schedule. Wire a periodic check (run/portfolio tick) that calls parked_review() and emits follow_up_due, and surface a 'Follow-ups due' list in the dashboard (part of the MVP work-management view).

decisions.note: [P2] Intake/backlog: wire parked follow-up surfacing (parked_review -> follow_up_due).
